rules.primary_cells: E0, E1 (D = 1.0), E2 pooled over L1-L4, per TF x window x R (36)
rules.design: Part 1 classification (min 100 fills, 20 days), Holm over the 36 primary cells
rules.holdout: CONFIRMED = HOLDOUT p passes Holm over the 24 E1 + E2 primary cells at alpha 0.05 and DESIGN mean net R > 0; INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_N below 30 fills or 10 days; E0 is the BASELINE and never confirmed
rules.samples: by the event's break-candle date; HOLDOUT from 2026-07-01
rules.e2_window: decided by the fill time; E0/E1 by the breakout close
